description: Battery energy storage projects in the ERCOT interconnection queue (GIS report) near a Texas address or coordinate, in a county, or at a named point of interconnection: developer, MW, POI substation, study stage (screening, FIS started, FIS complete, IA signed, energized), projected COD, co-location with solar or wind, plus totals (projects, MW, MW with signed IA, MW by zone). Use when someone asks what storage is planned near a site, how crowded a substation is with batteries, who is developing storage in a county, or which queued batteries have interconnection agreements. Pair with volatile_nodes to compare spreads against competition. Free accounts get every location and type; names, sizes, owners and dates are Pro.

address.description: Texas street address, e.g. '1201 Main St, Houston, TX'. Use this or lat/lng.

county.description: Texas county name. Use this or a location or poi.

lat.description: Latitude (WGS84). Use with lng instead of address.

lng.description: Longitude (WGS84). Use with lat instead of address.

poi.description: Point of interconnection substation name or bus number to match, e.g. 'Lolita' or 'Hillje'.

radius_mi.description: Radius around the location in miles. Default 15, max 100.

status.description: all (default), active = not yet energized, ia = interconnection agreement signed or energized, energized only.

name: battery_queue
title: ERCOT battery storage queue
